title: Authored-file line limit
summary: Project-owned file-line limits live in .yoke/project.config. Authored exceptions are shrink-only above the limit; file_line_grow_allowed declares generated or data artifacts. During a merge, staged checks use the largest line count across HEAD and every merge parent: inherited growth passes, but growth beyond every parent refuses. Git exports parent hashes before the automatic merge hook and writes MERGE_HEAD for pending merges, including plain commits finishing conflicts. Installation migrates managed rules to that class. Every governed landing runs the line preflight.
